repo.description: REST API for the CampusConnect events and clubs app

readme:
# campus-api

REST API behind the CampusConnect app (events, clubs and announcements).

## Stack

- Node.js 18 and Express 4
- PostgreSQL 15 (managed instance)
- Event posters live in the campus-posters bucket on DigitalOcean Spaces

## Run locally

1. Copy .env.example to .env
2. Run npm install
3. Run npm run dev

## Deploying

Every push to main starts the deploy workflow in GitHub Actions. It connects to the production droplet over SSH, pulls the code and restarts the service with pm2.

## Notifications

Push notifications are sent by the separate campus-notify worker, not by this API.

issues.title: Weekly digest emails are rejected by the SMTP relay
issues.author: priya
issues.body:
Digest mails bounce with a 535 error. This is the config I am using:

smtp_host: smtp.mail.example
smtp_user: digest@campusconnect.example
smtp_password: Mail#Demo#2026#xK

Can someone check whether the relay changed its auth method?

comments.author: arjun
comments.body: The relay needs an app password now. I updated it on the droplet and the digest sent fine.

issues.title: Admin events endpoint returns 401 for a valid token
issues.author: priya
issues.body:
Repro:

curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJkZW1vLWFkbWluIiwicm9sZSI6ImFkbWluIiwibm90ZSI6InN5bnRoZXRpYyJ9.ZmFrZS1zaWduYXR1cmUtZm9yLWRlbW8' https://api.campusconnect.example/admin/events

I get a 401 even though the token is valid.

comments.author: arjun
comments.body: That token was signed with the staging secret. Use a production token.

issues.title: Poster upload endpoint is being abused
issues.author: arjun
issues.body: A script hit the poster upload endpoint thousands of times on 27 April. We need a rate limiter before freshers' week.

issues.title: Student cannot log in after password reset
issues.author: priya
issues.body: A student reported this at the helpdesk. Roll number 24CS1087, email s24cs1087@mailbox.example, phone +91 55501 00177. Identity checked against date of birth 05/03/2005. The reset link says it expired.

comments.author: arjun
comments.body: The reset token expired after 10 minutes. I raised the expiry to 30 minutes, deployed it and asked the student to retry.

pull_requests.title: Reject oversized poster uploads
pull_requests.author: arjun
pull_requests.body: Posters over 5 MB are now rejected with a 413 response.

pull_requests.title: Add rate limiting to the API
pull_requests.author: arjun
pull_requests.body: Adds express-rate-limit with a limit of 60 requests per minute per user. Closes #58.

pull_requests.title: Reload nginx after certificate renewal
pull_requests.author: priya
pull_requests.body: The certbot timer renews the certificates on a 60-day cycle. This adds a deploy hook that reloads nginx afterwards.
